snippet.title: Construction Simulator Evolution World Premiere Reveal Trailer | Galaxies Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Grab your hard hats, Construction Simulator: Evolution delivers a HUGE suite of new features and content including demolition, manual labor, Volvo as a new license partner, as well as two brand new maps, each with its own challenging campaign. The game is coming to PC, PS5 and the XBox series consoles soon. 

Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45348822/sale/spring2026
